definitions.explanation: Done without prior planning or preparation.
Someone who has recently become interested in something (often implying superficiality).

examples.english: I got caught in a sudden rain shower.

examples.japanese: {俄|にわか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't believe it immediately / all of a sudden.

examples.japanese: ⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{俄|にわか}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of bandwagon soccer fans has increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{俄|にわか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: His condition suddenly took a turn for the worse.

examples.japanese: {俄|にわか}⟦{仕立|じた}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: They performed a play on a hastily put-together stage.

examples.japanese: {俄|にわか}⟦{作|づく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
examples.english: A hastily thrown-together plan will probably fail.

examples.japanese: {俄|にわか}⟦{仕立|じた}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
{俄|にわか}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われたくない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be seen as a bandwagon fan.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワールドカップ→ワールドカップ：27456_waarudokappu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{俄|にわか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: When the World Cup season comes around, the bandwagon fans increase.

notes:
{俄|にわか} is a na-adjective meaning sudden or impromptu, with a modern slang usage for "novice" or "bandwagon."

FORMS:
- {俄|にわか}な + noun (sudden ~)
- {俄|にわか}に (suddenly - adverbial)
- {俄|にわか} + noun (impromptu/novice ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {俄|にわか}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (sudden rain shower)
- {俄|にわか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to suddenly become busy)
- {俄|にわか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (can't immediately believe)
- {俄|にわか}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (bandwagon fan)

MODERN SLANG:
In contemporary usage, {俄|にわか} (or にわか) is often used as a noun/prefix to describe someone who has recently started following a trend, sport, or hobby without deep knowledge. It can have a slightly dismissive nuance:
- にわか⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (bandwagon fan)
- にわか⟦オタク→オタク：15181_otaku⟧ (casual/fake otaku)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俄|にわか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ vs. ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: Both mean "suddenly," but {俄|にわか}に can also imply "hastily" or "for the time being."

KANJI:
Often written in hiragana as にわか in modern usage.
